family.description: NTPase_I-T is a family of NTPases with supreme activity against ITP and XTP. Active site analysis and structure comparison of YjjX strongly suggested that it is an NTP binding protein with nucleoside triphosphatase activity. YjjX exhibits a mixed alpha-beta fold [[cite:PUB00038960],[cite:PUB00037841]].

record.description: NTPase_I-T is a family of NTPases with supreme activity against ITP and XTP. Active site analysis and structure comparison of YjjX strongly suggested that it is an NTP binding protein with nucleoside triphosphatase activity. YjjX exhibits a mixed alpha-beta fold [[cite:PUB00038960],[cite:PUB00037841]].

evidence.explanation: Substrate exclusions, GDP Km and Mn activity differ between prose and tables; deposited and primer-derived N termini also differ.
Figure7I labels ATRAP while its images, legend and Results identify ATG9A; supplement-dependent construct details remain unavailable.

discussions.notes: Retain MLI versus primer-suggested MLLI extension,5mM standard versus10mM kinetic Mg, and unavailable PNAS supplementary methods. TPP is thiamine pyrophosphate. Human PRRC1 accession identifies the gene, not verified sequence identity of every experimental clone.
discussions.prompt: Resolve construct numbering, primary-source discrepancies and missing supplementary methods.
discussions.rationale: Assay-specific effects are supported without identifying every construct or silently normalizing conflicting statements.

evidence.explanation: Zebrafish misty-somites developmental study is a discovered follow-up, not a reviewed graph.
Mys-PKA regulation needs construct-mapped primary methods and figure review.

discussions.notes: See coverage ledger for Lawhorn thiamine-antimetabolite screen, VC0702/1U14, Thermoplasma fusions and Liu2025 thesis. No RNA-protection, translation-inhibition, PRRC1 NTP hydrolysis or family-wide negative conclusion is established here.
discussions.prompt: Extend primary review to zebrafish Mys, domain-specific PRRC1 assays and other NTPase_I-T members.
discussions.rationale: YjjX and whole-human-PRRC1 assays do not characterize every frozen family member or prove isolated PF01931 function.
